full_text: Alex: We reviewed the onboarding launch and agreed to publish the revised checklist on Friday. Priya: I will update the customer setup guide by Thursday afternoon. Jordan: I can validate the deployment checklist tomorrow. Alex: The analytics question is still open; we need Finance to confirm the reporting definition. The team discussed options for launch support, but made no decision to change the release date.

Dana: Let us start with what went well this sprint. Sam: The new onboarding screens shipped on time. Priya: Support tickets about setup dropped by a third. Dana: What should we improve? Sam: Our estimates for the reporting work were too optimistic. Dana: Agreed, we will break reporting tasks into smaller pieces. Sam: I will draft the new estimation template by Wednesday. Priya: I will share the support ticket summary with the team on Monday.

Maria: Walk me through the incident timeline. Jordan: The deployment started at 11:05 and alerts fired at 11:20. Maria: What was the cause? Jordan: A configuration value was missing in the staging environment. Maria: We decided to add a configuration check to the release checklist. Jordan: I will write the check and have it reviewed by Friday.
